snippet.title: Sonic ERaZor – Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 *Download and more info:* https://sonic-erazor.selbi.club

Sonic ERaZor is a chaotic, cinematic, explosive ROM hack of Sonic the Hedgehog — 15 years in the making!

Version 8.1 is out now, which also introduces: "Zenith Edition" — a new port of the widescreen version as a standalone Windows EXE. No setup required, just download and begin playing right away!

---

Credits:
Music: Eject by Soundridemusic
Link to Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MTUQoC9_DGE
